requirements.text: Customers should be able to choose a service and a specific barber.
Customers should see available time slots for appointments.
Immediate confirmation of appointments is essential.
Customers would benefit from reminder notifications before their appointments.
The ability for customers to cancel or change their appointments online.
Barbers should be able to set their own schedules.
The system needs to be affordable and not overly complicated.
The system should provide a summary or dashboard for tracking bookings and no-shows.
